keyPoints.en: The boundary protocol of the Bangkok Treaty (1909) split the northern Malay lands between Britain and Siam.
keyPoints.bm: Protokol sempadan Perjanjian Bangkok (1909) memecahbelahkan wilayah negeri-negeri Melayu utara antara British dan Siam.

keyPoints.en: Some areas, such as Setul (once part of Kedah) and the Patani region, stayed under Siam.
keyPoints.bm: Sesetengah kawasan, seperti Setul (dahulu sebahagian Kedah) dan wilayah Patani, kekal di bawah Siam.

keyPoints.en: Northern rulers were unhappy because they had not been consulted.
keyPoints.bm: Pemerintah negeri-negeri Melayu utara tidak berpuas hati kerana tidak dirunding.

keyPoints.en: Johor's rulers wisely used diplomacy and a constitution to hold back the British.
keyPoints.bm: Pemerintah Johor dengan bijaksana menggunakan diplomasi dan perlembagaan untuk menyekat kemaraan British.

meaning.en: Part of the 1909 treaty that fixed the new border between British Malaya and Siam.
meaning.bm: Sebahagian perjanjian 1909 yang menetapkan sempadan baharu antara Tanah Melayu British dan Siam.

meaning.en: Using negotiation and good relations instead of force.
meaning.bm: Menggunakan rundingan dan hubungan baik, bukan kekerasan.

points.en: Kedah, Kelantan and Terengganu protested that their states had been traded without consent.
points.bm: Kedah, Kelantan dan Terengganu membantah kerana negeri mereka dipindahkan tanpa persetujuan.

points.en: Terengganu accepted only a British Agent (1910) and delayed a full Adviser until 1919; Kedah delayed a formal treaty until 1923.
points.bm: Terengganu hanya menerima Ejen British (1910) dan melambatkan Penasihat penuh hingga 1919; Kedah melambatkan perjanjian rasmi hingga 1923.

points.en: Sultan Abu Bakar built friendships in London and signed the 1885 treaty on his own terms.
points.bm: Sultan Abu Bakar menjalin persahabatan di London dan menandatangani perjanjian 1885 mengikut syaratnya sendiri.

points.en: The 1895 constitution forbade handing Johor to any foreign power.
points.bm: Perlembagaan 1895 melarang Johor diserahkan kepada mana-mana kuasa asing.

question.en: How did the northern rulers react to the Bangkok Treaty?
question.bm: Bagaimanakah pemerintah negeri-negeri Melayu utara bertindak balas terhadap Perjanjian Bangkok?

answer.en: They were unhappy at not being consulted and delayed accepting British Advisers as long as they could.
answer.bm: Mereka tidak berpuas hati kerana tidak dirunding dan melambatkan penerimaan Penasihat British selama yang boleh.

keyPoints.en: Malay rulers met Western challenges in five ways.
keyPoints.bm: Raja-raja Melayu menangani cabaran Barat melalui lima cara.

keyPoints.en: Demands through the Durbar, diplomacy, refusing British Advisers, written constitutions and leading modernisation.
keyPoints.bm: Tuntutan melalui Durbar, diplomasi, keengganan menerima Penasihat British, menggubal Undang-undang Tubuh dan menerajui pemodenan negeri.

meaning.en: A written state constitution — Johor (1895), Terengganu (1911).
Conference of the FMS rulers, where they could voice demands.
meaning.bm: Persidangan raja-raja NNMB, tempat mereka menyuarakan tuntutan.

points.en: 1. Demands through the Durbar: at the 1903 Durbar Sultan Idris of Perak asked for more Malays in the government and less centralisation.
points.bm: 1. Tuntutan melalui Durbar: dalam Durbar 1903 Sultan Idris Perak meminta lebih ramai orang Melayu dalam pentadbiran dan kurang pemusatan kuasa.

points.en: 2. Diplomacy: e.g. Sultan Abu Bakar of Johor.
points.bm: 2. Diplomasi: cth. Sultan Abu Bakar dari Johor.

points.en: 3. Northern rulers refused or delayed British Advisers (e.g. Terengganu until 1919).
points.bm: 3. Pemerintah negeri utara enggan atau melambatkan penerimaan Penasihat British (cth. Terengganu hingga 1919).

points.en: 4. Written constitutions: Johor 1895; Terengganu 1911 (Sultan Zainal Abidin III).
points.bm: 4. Menggubal Undang-undang Tubuh: Johor 1895; Terengganu 1911 (Sultan Zainal Abidin III).

points.en: 5. Rulers led modernisation: government departments, schools and state forces (e.g. Johor Military Forces, 1886).
points.bm: 5. Raja menerajui pemodenan: jabatan kerajaan, sekolah dan pasukan tentera negeri (cth. Askar Timbalan Setia Negeri Johor, 1886).

question.en: Why did Johor and Terengganu introduce written constitutions?
question.bm: Mengapakah Johor dan Terengganu menggubal Undang-undang Tubuh?

answer.en: To show they were modern, organised states and to protect their sovereignty — Johor's forbade handing the state to a foreign power.
answer.bm: Untuk menunjukkan negeri mereka moden dan tersusun serta melindungi kedaulatan — Undang-undang Tubuh Johor melarang negeri diserahkan kepada kuasa asing.

keyPoints.en: Malay chiefs helped modernise their states in many fields.
keyPoints.bm: Pembesar Melayu membantu memodenkan negeri dalam pelbagai bidang.

keyPoints.en: Kedah's Wan Mohd Saman built a canal to irrigate padi fields (Terusan Wan Mat Saman).
keyPoints.bm: Wan Mohd Saman dari Kedah membina terusan untuk mengairi sawah padi (Terusan Wan Mat Saman).

keyPoints.en: Johor's first Menteri Besar, Dato' Jaafar Muhammad, built a modern administration.
keyPoints.bm: Menteri Besar Johor yang pertama, Dato' Jaafar Muhammad, membina pentadbiran moden.

keyPoints.en: Raja Chulan became the first Malay unofficial member of the FMS Federal Council (1924).
keyPoints.bm: Raja Chulan menjadi ahli tidak rasmi Melayu yang pertama dalam Majlis Mesyuarat Persekutuan NNMB (1924).

meaning.en: Irrigation canal in Kedah built in the late 1800s to boost rice farming.
meaning.bm: Terusan pengairan di Kedah yang dibina pada akhir 1800-an untuk meningkatkan penanaman padi.

meaning.en: Introducing new ways of running government, the economy and education.
meaning.bm: Memperkenalkan cara baharu mengurus kerajaan, ekonomi dan pendidikan.

points.en: 1–2. Socio-economic and agricultural development: canals, padi farming and new crops.
points.bm: 1–2. Pembangunan sosioekonomi dan pertanian: terusan, penanaman padi dan tanaman baharu.

points.en: 3. Urban development: new towns and better facilities (e.g. Johor Bahru).
points.bm: 3. Pembangunan bandar: bandar baharu dan kemudahan yang lebih baik (cth. Johor Bahru).

points.en: 4. Administration and education: government departments, Malay officers and schools.
points.bm: 4. Pentadbiran dan pendidikan: jabatan kerajaan, pegawai Melayu dan sekolah.

points.en: 5. Members of the Federal Council, e.g. Raja Chulan, voiced Malay interests.
points.bm: 5. Ahli Majlis Mesyuarat Persekutuan, cth. Raja Chulan, menyuarakan kepentingan orang Melayu.

points.en: 6. Local leadership in Sarawak and Sabah: Datu and native chiefs led their communities within the new administration.
points.bm: 6. Kepimpinan tempatan di Sarawak dan Sabah: Datu dan ketua anak negeri memimpin masyarakat dalam pentadbiran baharu.

question.en: How did Wan Mohd Saman's canal show wise leadership?
question.bm: Bagaimanakah terusan Wan Mohd Saman menunjukkan kepimpinan yang bijaksana?

answer.en: It was a local initiative that improved farmers' income and the state's food supply without depending on the British.
answer.bm: Ia inisiatif tempatan yang meningkatkan pendapatan petani dan bekalan makanan negeri tanpa bergantung pada British.

keyPoints.en: The rulers' and chiefs' efforts had important results.
keyPoints.bm: Usaha raja dan pembesar membawa hasil yang penting.

keyPoints.en: States prospered, British expansion was slowed, and education progressed.
keyPoints.bm: Negeri menjadi makmur, peluasan kuasa British dilambatkan, dan pendidikan maju.

keyPoints.en: The Malay Regiment was set up (1933), Malay officers entered the civil service, and the institution of the monarchy was preserved.
keyPoints.bm: Askar Melayu ditubuhkan (1933), pegawai Melayu memasuki perkhidmatan awam, dan institusi beraja dipertahankan.

meaning.en: Formed on 1 March 1933 at Port Dickson, starting with 25 recruits.
meaning.bm: Ditubuhkan pada 1 Mac 1933 di Port Dickson, bermula dengan 25 orang rekrut.

meaning.en: Scheme (1910) that trained Malays as government officers.
meaning.bm: Skim (1910) yang melatih orang Melayu sebagai pegawai kerajaan.

points.en: 1. Prosperity: modern administration and farming made states richer.
points.bm: 1. Kemakmuran negeri: pentadbiran dan pertanian moden menjadikan negeri lebih kaya.

points.en: 2. British expansion delayed — Johor until 1914, Terengganu until 1919, Kedah until 1923.
points.bm: 2. Peluasan kuasa British dilambatkan — Johor hingga 1914, Terengganu hingga 1919, Kedah hingga 1923.

points.en: 3. Education: Malay schools and colleges such as MCKK (1905) grew.
points.bm: 3. Kemajuan pendidikan: sekolah Melayu dan kolej seperti MCKK (1905) berkembang.

points.en: 4. Malay Regiment (1933): the rulers supported a Malay military force.
points.bm: 4. Penubuhan Askar Melayu (1933): raja-raja menyokong pasukan tentera Melayu.

points.en: 5. Malay administrative officers (MAS, 1910).
points.bm: 5. Pegawai Tadbir Melayu (MAS, 1910).

points.en: 6. The institution of the monarchy was defended — still at the heart of Malaysia's constitution.
points.bm: 6. Institusi beraja dipertahankan — masih menjadi teras Perlembagaan Malaysia.

alt.bm: Anggota Askar Melayu, yang ditubuhkan pada 1933, berlatih bayonet di Singapura, 1941.

question.en: Why can the rulers' actions be called "wise" even though British influence still grew?
question.bm: Mengapakah tindakan raja-raja boleh dianggap "bijaksana" walaupun pengaruh British tetap berkembang?

answer.en: They avoided bloodshed, delayed British control, modernised their states and preserved the monarchy and Malay institutions that continue today.
answer.bm: Mereka mengelakkan pertumpahan darah, melambatkan penguasaan British, memodenkan negeri dan mempertahankan institusi beraja serta institusi Melayu yang kekal hingga kini.
